description: Hand-authored golden evaluation set for Grounded. Each question is written against the real RBI corpus and mapped to the document that should contain the answer. 'answerable': false items are out-of-scope and MUST be declined (refusal test). Used for retrieval-recall, refusal-accuracy, and NLI faithfulness evaluation.
